senses.gloss: (cmp. ברדלא) pr. n. pl. Bard’laya, near Lydda (v. infra).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8:8">Y. Erub. VI, 24ᵃ</cite> top <he>אנשי בר דליה</he> the inhabitants of B.
